title: DecisionRequest
description: Core -> AI service: one inhabitant asks the decider which of the offered options to take.

seed.description: Sampling seed derived by the core from world seed and tick (determinism).

deadline_ms.description: Wall-clock budget for the AI service. When exceeded the service returns ServiceError 'timeout' and never makes a substitute decision; the core decides at a fixed tick and logs the outcome for replay.

options.description: Actions the core currently allows. The decider must pick exactly one of them.

inhabitants.description: Other inhabitants in sight, nearest first.

target.description: Target instance, or null for actions without target.

partners.description: Further objects used together with target (e.g. combine flint with pyrite), sorted by id; empty for actions with one object or none.

topic.description: For actions that pass knowledge on to the target inhabitant (show, teach, warn; B4a R4, D625): WHAT the asker would pass on. This is the asker's own belief that the core would pass, never the world's truth. Optional (absent = the action passes nothing on, or an older core).

object_type.description: Kind of thing the belief is about (object type id; content types are named by the data, i18n key vocab.object.<id>).

name.description: The inhabitants' own name for a thing they invented (runtime type, not in the data), in both languages; null for content types, which the data names.

property.description: The property the asker believes about it (vocabulary property, e.g. poisonous).

value.description: What the asker believes: the thing has the property (true) or not (false). Its belief, which can be wrong.

EnvironmentState.description: What the inhabitant can sense right now. Deliberately no season name: inhabitants must learn that seasons exist and return (concept). A season concept reaches the model only through the inhabitant's own knowledge.

time_of_day.description: Vocabulary kind time_of_day (dawn, day, dusk, night).

temperature_c.description: AIR temperature at the inhabitant's place (weather, season, height). What the inhabitant feels personally (clothing, wet, conditions) is InhabitantState.felt_temperature_c (B2540).

weather.description: All current weather conditions (vocabulary kind weather), e.g. rain and storm together. Sorted by id by the core.

visibility_m.description: How far the inhabitant sees right now, in metres (B2594): the core's perception radius scaled by the weather (fog, rain, snow; light follows with B5). Things and inhabitants beyond it are not in the perception lists. Optional; absent = not stated.

visible_conditions.description: Signs others can SEE (vocabulary sign: limping, lying down, pale; which felt condition shows which sign is core data), never the cause (B2543). Optional until the core sends it.

called.description: B9 R11: how THIS inhabitant calls the other - per-observer state in the core, not a world property. name = a proper name it knows (Latin letters, checked by the core and the guard), label = a feature label (vocabulary, shown via i18n) until a name is known. Optional.

life_stage.description: B9: the visible life phase (child or adult), needed for R7/R27. Optional.

lying_still.description: B9 R16: lies still and does not answer; the core alone knows why. Optional.
